# Inspector

X-ray for a page built with Ouro HX: outlines every Ouro component on the page with its name, linked to its docs, and lists them all for keyboard and screen reader users. Each tag names the component's registry item; the bar at the bottom opens the list (a `Sheet`), every component in document order with its "Docs" and, from `sourceHref`, "Source" links. Outlines follow their components through scrolling, resizing, overlays and changes to the page, measured once a frame at most; they never take a pointer, so the page stays usable underneath, and only the tags do. X-ray shows only what a person can see and reach: an outline is cut to the part a scrolling box lets show, a tag hides while a menu or a list lies over it, the page behind an open modal dialog is left alone, and a part (a Radio) counts with its component (its RadioGroup). X-ray never draws over the page's text: an outline's edge breaks where a line of text crosses it, and a tag sits where it covers no text and no other tag, or hides. Its bar is a landmark named by `label`. Escape or Close turns it off, once Escape has closed any other overlay. It renders nothing on the server.

```tsx
import { Inspector } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/inspector/inspector";
```

## Example

```tsx
const [xray, setXray] = useState(false);
<Switch label="X-ray" checked={xray} onCheckedChange={setXray} />
<Inspector open={xray} onOpenChange={setXray} />
<Inspector open={xray} onOpenChange={setXray} sourceHref={(item) => sourceOf(item)} />
```

## Use instead when

- Use your browser's developer tools instead when you need more than which component is where; the `data-ouro`, `data-ouro-control` and `data-ouro-part` attributes X-ray reads are there too.

## Props

Type: `InspectorProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `docsHref` | `((item: string) => string)` |  | The address of an item's docs page, from its registry name, where each tag and the list link. Without it they link to Ouro's public docs, `https://ui.ouro.bot/docs/<item>/`. |
| `label` | `string` | `"X-ray"` | What X-ray is called, on its bar and as its list's title. Translate it here. |
| `onOpenChange` (required) | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with `false` when the person closes X-ray (its Close button, or Escape). |
| `open` (required) | `boolean` |  | Whether X-ray is on: outlines over every Ouro component, and the bar with the list. Pair it with `onOpenChange`. |
| `sourceHref` | `((item: string, element: Element) => string \| undefined)` |  | The address of the source that renders a component, if you publish it: the list shows a Source link where this returns one. |

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `isOpen`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `open` with `onOpenChange`: `<Inspector open={xray} onOpenChange={setXray}>`.
- `onClose`: Not a prop. `onOpenChange` gets `false` when X-ray closes: `onOpenChange={setXray}`.
